latest_messages.headline: Open: no trades - strong jobs report, market bounced, all four stocks fine
latest_messages.body: Market opened and I placed no orders. October's jobs report came in strong (+165k jobs vs ~65k expected, unemployment 4.1%), and after yesterday's -4.4% drop the market opened up ~+0.35% in relief; our worry stock Cadence rose +0.67% and pulled safely above its auto-sell. No buying: our open slot needs a livelier non-defensive name (we're capped at 2 calm/defensive stocks and hold 3) and none was clean enough; and spare cash ($10,558) sits right at the ~$10k cushion, so nothing extra to add to our S&P 500 holding. Honest note: this is the mirror of yesterday - our steady stocks lag on a bounce-back day, so we're -0.50% intraday while the market is +0.35%. Expected trade-off, not a problem; final score comes at the 3pm close. Equity $95,640; cash ~11%; 4 of 5 slots, 1 of 3 weekly buys used; all 4 safety-net orders confirmed.
